entries.q: Can I get a refund?
entries.a: Because designs are digital files that can't be returned, purchases are generally final. Genuine file problems are handled through support, with a corrected file, a replacement download or another reasonable fix. Examples that qualify: a corrupted or unopenable ZIP, a missing listed file, a serious technical defect, the wrong product delivered, a verified duplicate purchase, or a product materially different from its listing.

entries.q: Which situations do not qualify for a refund?
also: file doesnt work with my machine refund
entries.a: A refund or replacement is normally not provided if you changed your mind, bought the wrong design when the listing was clear, expected a physical item, your machine or software isn't compatible, you're unsure how to use your software, your settings or materials gave an unexpected result, you edited or converted the file incorrectly, or you found a design you prefer. Please check the formats and license on the product page before buying.

entries.q: My file is corrupted, missing or won't open. What do I do?
entries.a: Please contact us as soon as possible, ideally within 3 calendar days of purchase. Include your order number, the product name, a short description of the problem and, if useful, a screenshot or error message. We will try to correct or replace the files.

entries.q: I bought the same design twice. What can I do?
entries.a: Contact us promptly with your order details. Once the duplicate purchase is verified, we may provide an appropriate remedy.

entries.q: If I am refunded, can I keep using the design?
entries.a: If a refund is approved, the license for that design may be terminated. You would need to stop using the design and delete the files unless we confirm otherwise in writing. A refund doesn't give you any right to keep selling or sharing work based on the refunded file.

entries.q: Should I dispute the payment with my bank?
entries.a: Please contact us before starting a chargeback whenever possible. We will make reasonable efforts to investigate genuine billing or delivery problems and find a fair resolution.

entries.q: Can I sell products I make with your designs?
entries.a: Where a design includes commercial use, you can create and sell finished physical products with it, such as ornaments, signs, earrings, keychains and layered decor. The digital file itself can't be resold, shared, uploaded or redistributed. Free designs are for personal, non-commercial use unless the product page says otherwise, and any product-specific terms take priority.

entries.q: Can I resell or share the digital file?
also: give the file to a friend
send the file to someone else
entries.a: No. You can't sell, give away, share or upload the digital file. That includes sharing with customers, friends, contractors or production partners, uploading to file libraries, marketplaces or groups, and including it in another downloadable product. Edited, converted, traced or resized versions of the file can't be resold either.

entries.q: Can I resize, recolor or personalize a design?
entries.a: Yes, for the physical product you're making you can resize, recolor, personalize, layer or otherwise adjust a design. These changes don't transfer ownership of the artwork and don't give you the right to sell the edited digital file.

entries.q: How many products can I make with one design?
also: how many times can i use
entries.a: With a commercially licensed design you can make unlimited physical copies, unless the product page states a different limit.

entries.q: Can I use free designs commercially?
entries.a: Free designs are for personal, non-commercial crafting unless the specific product page says otherwise. Please don't resell, share or include a free design in another digital product. Check the individual listing for any special terms.

entries.q: Can I show photos of my finished products to advertise them?
entries.a: Yes. You can use photographs or mockups of your finished physical products in your own advertising and product listings. You just can't present the original digital design as your own work.

entries.q: What will I receive after buying a design?
entries.a: You receive one ZIP package with the files provided for that design. The product page shows the ZIP size and the file types the owner has listed. Your files unlock in My Account once payment completes.

entries.q: Which file formats are included?
entries.a: Designs are prepared as SVG, PNG and DXF, and some also include AI or EPS where listed. Each product page lists the file types that are actually in its ZIP.

entries.q: Will the files work with my machine or software?
entries.a: Designs are prepared for laser cutting and for Cricut and Silhouette workflows. Check the What's included box on each product page for its file types. We can't guarantee compatibility with every machine or software setup, so please contact us before buying if you need to confirm.

entries.q: Are there subscriptions or memberships?
entries.a: No. Each design is a one-time purchase. There are no memberships or subscription plans.

entries.q: Do I need an account?
also: do i need to log in to buy
entries.a: You can browse the whole shop without an account. An account is used to unlock your downloads and keep your orders, licenses and saved designs in one place. You sign up with your email (we send a code to confirm it) and then log in with your email and password, or use Google or Apple where those options are shown.

entries.q: Where do I find my downloads and orders?
also: didnt get my files after buying
entries.a: After a purchase completes, your ZIP appears under My Account, in the Downloads section, and your orders and licenses are listed there too. If something is missing, contact us with your order number.

entries.q: How fast will I get my files?
also: how long until i get it
entries.a: Delivery is digital and instant. Once a purchase is completed, the download becomes available in your customer account, linked to your order and license record.

entries.q: Do you ship physical products?
entries.a: No. Craftshan Studio sells digital design files only, unless a listing clearly says otherwise, so nothing is shipped.

entries.q: How do payments work and is my card information safe?
entries.a: Paid checkout is handled by a third-party payment provider (Lemon Squeezy) on its own secure page. We don't intend to store full card numbers. Please never type card details into this chat.

entries.q: Can I buy a design right now?
entries.a: Yes. Add designs to your cart and check out. Your files unlock in My Account after payment.
entries.a_not_live: Online checkout isn't switched on yet, so orders can't be placed right now. You can browse the designs and licensing information, and use the contact page if you have questions.

entries.q: Do you have discounts or coupon codes?
entries.a: Sales appear on the home page and on product pages. If you have a discount code, enter it in your cart and press Apply.

entries.q: Do you make custom designs?
entries.a: The contact page has a Custom design request option. Send your idea there and the owner will reply by email. I can't confirm availability or pricing here.

entries.q: How can I contact you or get help from a person?
entries.a: Use the contact form on the Contact page. Choose a subject (general enquiry, licensing, custom design, technical issue or billing), add your order number if you have one, and you will get a reply by email.

entries.q: What personal information do you collect?
entries.a: We collect what the store needs to run, such as your name, email, orders, support messages and technical information. Payment details are handled by the payment provider. We don't sell personal information as a normal part of the business. The Privacy Policy has the full details.

entries.q: Do you use cookies or tracking?
entries.a: The store only uses storage it needs to work: your sign-in, cart and display preferences. It doesn't currently run analytics or advertising trackers. You can change your choice any time from Cookie preferences in the footer.

entries.q: How can I see, correct or delete my personal data?
entries.a: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete your information. Use the contact page to make a privacy request and include enough detail for us to understand it. Some records may need to be kept for legal, accounting or licensing reasons.

entries.q: Are the reviews real?
entries.a: Only genuine customer-submitted reviews are shown, and they are tied to verified orders. We never display invented reviews.

entries.q: Who runs Craftshan Studio?
entries.a: Craftshan Studio is an independent digital design store run by its founder, M Kashian Malik, focused on practical laser-cut and crafting design files.
